sub_indicators.label: Interoperability of education systems
sub_indicators.subject: dpi.exchange
sub_indicators.text: Interoperability of education systems: interoperability of education systems
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Digital Education Strategy asks for an individual, identifier-based education management information system linked to the national ID and other sectors.
criteria: A source from the past three years says the country's education systems exchange no data.
A link between two education systems is contracted, being built or piloted.
Two education systems exchange data in use: the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.
Learners carry a unique identifier used by two or more education systems.
Learner records are linked to the national ID, civil registration, health or social protection.

aspects.name: One learner identifier across education systems
Linked to the national ID or another sector
